name: pulmonary mass
definition: A space-occupying lesion of the lung exceeding 30 mm.

elements.name: presence
elements.definition: Whether the observation is judged to be present on this examination.

permitted_values.name: present
permitted_values.definition: Observation can be confidently categorized as present based on the data presented to the interpreter.

permitted_values.name: absent
permitted_values.definition: Observation can be confidently categorized as absent based on the data presented to the interpreter.

permitted_values.name: indeterminate
permitted_values.definition: The data presented do not permit categorization as present or absent.

permitted_values.name: unknown
permitted_values.definition: No determination was made, or the examination did not address it.

elements.name: interval change
elements.definition: The relationship of the finding to the same finding on a prior comparable examination.

permitted_values.name: new
permitted_values.definition: Not present on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: unchanged
permitted_values.definition: Without appreciable difference from the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: increased
permitted_values.definition: Larger or more numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: decreased
permitted_values.definition: Smaller or less numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: no prior available
permitted_values.definition: No comparable prior examination was available.

elements.name: pulmonary margin
elements.definition: The character of the interface between a pulmonary lesion and the surrounding lung.

permitted_values.name: smooth
permitted_values.definition: The interface is even and uninterrupted.

permitted_values.name: lobulated
permitted_values.definition: The interface undulates with rounded protrusions.

permitted_values.name: irregular
permitted_values.definition: The interface is uneven without a dominant pattern.

permitted_values.name: spiculated
permitted_values.definition: Radiating linear projections extend from the interface.

elements.name: distribution
elements.definition: The spatial pattern of a multifocal finding across the organ or region.

permitted_values.name: solitary
permitted_values.definition: A single lesion.

permitted_values.name: scattered
permitted_values.definition: Several lesions without a discernible pattern.

permitted_values.name: clustered
permitted_values.definition: Lesions grouped in one part of the organ.

elements.name: calcification
elements.definition: The presence and pattern of calcium within the lesion.

permitted_values.name: none
permitted_values.definition: No calcification is identified.

permitted_values.name: central
permitted_values.definition: Calcification occupies the centre of the lesion.

permitted_values.name: popcorn
permitted_values.definition: Coarse, clustered, chondroid calcification.

permitted_values.name: punctate
permitted_values.definition: Small discrete foci of calcification.

permitted_values.name: coarse
permitted_values.definition: Dense, chunky calcification without a specific pattern.

permitted_values.name: peripheral / rim
permitted_values.definition: Calcification at the margin of the lesion.

measurements.name: long-axis diameter
measurements.definition: The greatest diameter of the lesion on the plane showing its maximal dimension.
measurements.method: Greatest diameter on a single plane, measured on the sequence or window in which the lesion is best seen.

measurements.name: lesion count
measurements.definition: The number of discrete lesions of this class identified.
measurements.method: Count of discrete lesions; 'innumerable' is recorded as unbounded rather than as a number.
